items.title: Why Super Micro (SMCI) Stock Is Up Today
items.summary: Shares of server solutions provider Super Micro (NASDAQ:SMCI) jumped 4.3% in the afternoon session after the company began shipping server racks built for NVIDIA’s next-generation Vera Rubin AI architecture, according to TipRanks. The start of shipments reinforces SMCI’s role in the AI infrastructure supply chain. Vera Rubin–ready racks house and interconnect high-density systems that data centers need for advanced AI workloads, keeping the stock in the AI server buildout story.
